name: Quest Template
description: Definition of every quest: availability requirements, chaining, objectives, texts, emotes and rewards. Loaded at startup by ObjectMgr::LoadQuests; quests are offered via creature_questrelation/gameobject_questrelation and item_template StartQuest.

fields.name: Method
fields.help: 0 = quest is auto-completed on accept (no objectives/details), 2 = normal quest.

fields.name: Type
fields.help: QuestInfo.dbc id shown by the client (Elite, PvP, Dungeon, Raid...), 0 = normal quest.

fields.name: Quest Level
fields.help: Level used for XP/money/reputation calculation and quest log sorting. -1 = scales with player level.

fields.name: Min Level
fields.help: Minimum player level required to accept the quest.

fields.name: Max Level
fields.help: Maximum player level allowed to accept the quest, 255 = no limit.

fields.name: Zone Or Sort
fields.help: Positive = zone id the quest is listed under in the quest log, negative = QuestSort.dbc category (class/profession/seasonal quests).

fields.name: Suggested Players
fields.help: Suggested number of players to complete the quest, shown in the quest details.

fields.name: Limit Time
fields.help: Time limit in seconds to complete the quest after accepting, 0 = no limit.

fields.name: Quest Flags
fields.help: Client-side quest flags (sharable, daily, weekly, raid, PvP...).

fields.name: Required Classes
fields.help: Class mask required to accept the quest, 0 = any class.

fields.name: Required Races
fields.help: Race mask required to accept the quest, 0 = any race.

fields.name: Required Skill
fields.help: Skill required to accept the quest, 0 = none.

fields.name: Required Skill Value
fields.help: Minimum value of Required Skill.

fields.name: Required Condition
fields.help: conditions.condition_entry that must be satisfied to see and accept the quest, 0 = none.

fields.name: Condition
fields.help: Edit the condition tree referenced by Required Condition.

fields.name: Rep Objective Faction
fields.help: Faction for a reputation objective: the quest completes when Rep Objective Value is reached, 0 = none.

fields.name: Rep Objective Value
fields.help: Reputation value with Rep Objective Faction required to complete the quest.

fields.name: Required Min Rep Faction
fields.help: Faction with which a minimum reputation is required to accept the quest, 0 = none.

fields.name: Required Min Rep Value
fields.help: Minimum reputation with Required Min Rep Faction needed to accept the quest.

fields.name: Required Max Rep Faction
fields.help: Faction with which reputation must stay below a value to accept the quest, 0 = none.

fields.name: Required Max Rep Value
fields.help: Reputation with Required Max Rep Faction must be below this value to accept the quest.

fields.name: Prev Quest
fields.help: Positive = quest that must be rewarded before this one becomes available, negative = quest that must be active (in the quest log).

fields.name: Next Quest
fields.help: Quest that becomes available after this quest; if negative, the follow-up requires this quest to be active in the log instead of rewarded.

fields.name: Exclusive Group
fields.help: Quests sharing the same positive group: only one of them can be taken/rewarded. Same negative group: all of them must be rewarded before the follow-up opens.

fields.name: Breadcrumb For Quest
fields.help: This quest is a breadcrumb for the given quest: it becomes unavailable once that quest is completed or accepted.

fields.name: Next Quest In Chain
fields.help: Quest id shown to the client as the next quest of the chain (also enforced as an accept requirement).

fields.name: Next Quest In Chain
fields.help: Open the follow-up quest.

fields.name: Source Item
fields.help: Item given to the player when the quest is accepted (removed on abandon/reward).

fields.name: Source Item
fields.help: Open the item given when the quest is accepted.

fields.name: Source Item Count
fields.help: Number of Source Item given on accept.

fields.name: Source Spell
fields.help: Spell cast on the player when the quest is accepted.

fields.name: Required Item 1
fields.help: Item the player must deliver to complete the quest.

fields.name: Required Item 2
fields.help: Item the player must deliver to complete the quest.

fields.name: Required Item 3
fields.help: Item the player must deliver to complete the quest.

fields.name: Required Item 4
fields.help: Item the player must deliver to complete the quest.

fields.name: Required Source Item 1
fields.help: Quest-only source item dropped by objective-related kills or objects (not shown as an objective itself).

fields.name: Required Source Item 2
fields.help: Quest-only source item dropped by objective-related kills or objects (not shown as an objective itself).

fields.name: Required Source Item 3
fields.help: Quest-only source item dropped by objective-related kills or objects (not shown as an objective itself).

fields.name: Required Source Item 4
fields.help: Quest-only source item dropped by objective-related kills or objects (not shown as an objective itself).

fields.name: Required Creature Or GO 1
fields.help: Positive = creature entry to kill or receive kill credit for, negative = gameobject entry to use.

fields.name: Required Creature Or GO 2

fields.help: Positive = creature entry to kill or receive kill credit for, negative = gameobject entry to use.

fields.name: Required Spell Cast 1
fields.help: Spell that must be cast on the corresponding Required Creature Or GO to count the objective (instead of killing it).

fields.name: Required Spell Cast 2

fields.name: Required Spell Cast 4
fields.help: Spell that must be cast on the corresponding Required Creature Or GO to count the objective (instead of killing it).

fields.name: Details
fields.help: Quest description shown in the quest details window at the questgiver.

fields.name: Objectives
fields.help: Objectives summary text shown in the quest log.

fields.name: Offer Reward Text
fields.help: Text shown in the reward window at the quest ender.

fields.name: Request Items Text
fields.help: Text shown at the quest ender while the objectives are not complete yet.

fields.name: End Text
fields.help: Text shown in the quest log objectives section for exploration/event quests without other objectives.

fields.name: Objective Text 1
fields.help: Custom text for this objective slot, overrides the auto-generated kill/collect counter text.

fields.name: Reward Or Required Money
fields.help: Positive = money reward in copper, negative = money required to complete the quest.

fields.name: Reward Money Max Level
fields.help: Money (copper) given instead of experience when the player is at max level.

fields.name: Reward Title
fields.help: CharTitles.dbc id of the title rewarded to the player.

fields.name: Reward Honorable Kills
fields.help: Honor reward expressed as a number of honorable-kill equivalents at the player's level.

fields.name: Reward Spell
fields.help: Spell shown as reward in the quest log and cast on the player at reward (unless Reward Spell Cast is set).

fields.name: Reward Spell Cast
fields.help: Spell actually cast on the player at reward; Reward Spell is then only displayed.

fields.name: Reward Mail Template
fields.help: mail_loot_template / QuestMailSender mail template sent to the player after rewarding the quest.

fields.name: Reward Mail Delay
fields.help: Delay in seconds before the reward mail is sent.

fields.name: Complete Script
